description: Use this when a role (APPROVER, REVIEWER, OWNER, OPERATOR or a hashed role_id) decided on an agent's proposal. Pass `proposal_sha256`, `decision` (APPROVED, REFUSED, CHANGED), optionally `agreement_id`. Returns a chained, signed entry of the role's decision, never GAIP's. Free, no account; records a GAIP receipt only. Inputs must be public and non-personal.

agent_url.description: Optional: public https URL of the agent whose proposal was decided (the system identifier).

agreement_id.description: Optional: the wa_... Deals agreement from witness_accept_terms this decision concerns; the finding then lists it.

continuity_handle.description: Optional: your continuity handle (continuity_id, token); one is issued with the receipt when absent.

data_classification.description: PUBLIC (default) or NON_PERSONAL_PUBLIC. Never send personal data.

decision.description: The decision as recorded: APPROVED, REFUSED or CHANGED.

proposal_sha256.description: SHA-256 (64 hex) of what the agent proposed, computed by you; the proposal itself is never sent.

reason_sha256.description: Optional: SHA-256 (64 hex) of the reason you keep; anything but a hash is refused.

role.description: The role that decided: APPROVER, REVIEWER, OWNER or OPERATOR. Any other text is refused (ROLE_VOCABULARY); use role_id for your own id.

role_id.description: Optional: your own opaque role identifier (one token, no spaces). GAIP keeps it only as a keyed hash, never in clear.

name: witness_signoff
title: Record a role's decision on a proposal (sign-off)
